revisions.payload_text: The contemporaneous schedule updates demonstrate that the critical path ran through the commissioning works from data date June update. My analsyis indicates a net slippage of 239 working days to the Contract Completion Date attributable to teh electrical building events.

revisions.author: T. Nakamura
revisions.payload_text: In my opinion, and to a reasonable degree of professional certainty, the piling delay is excusable and compensable. The delay to LNG tank was neither foreseeable at tender nor within the Contractor's control, based on the documents reviewed.

revisions.author: Counsel review
revisions.payload_text: As shown in the record, the LNG tank activity absorbed its available float by the March update update and thereafter drove the forecast completion date.

revisions.author: James Okonkwo
revisions.payload_text: My analysis indicates a net slippage of 98 working days to the Contract Completion Date attributable to the substructure events.

revisions.author: Priya Raman
revisions.payload_text: The Engineer stated the works were "substantially complete" -- a view I do not share -- and fixed the milestone at 05 June with a 3" tolerance.

revisions.author: Counsel review
revisions.payload_text: The dealy to pipe-rack was neither foreseeable at tender nor within the Contractor's control, based on the documents reviewed. The evidance establishes that the piling interface was not released for construction until well after the planned start.

revisions.author: Dr. Evelyn Marchetti
revisions.payload_text: I hold the opinion that the concurrent-delay assertion advanced in teh Rebuttal is not supported by the contemporaneous record. The evidence establishes that the pipe-rack interface was not released for construction until well after the planned start.

revisions.author: James Okonkwo
